snippet.title: Shotgun Farmers - Vitamin Seas Supporter Pack Reveal
snippet.description:
Hoist the sails and join the crew with the Vitamin Seas Supporter Pack! This special DLC is for players who want to support Shotgun Farmers and join the legendary pirate crew. Packed with cursed cosmetics and exclusive rewards, this bundle brings the chaos of the high seas to the farm!

Get it on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4565680/Shotgun_Farmers__Vitamin_Seas_Supporter_Pack/

Get it on Xbox: 
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/vitamin-seas-supporter-pack/9P0FLV9GZ10F

Get it on Playstation: 
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP6313-CUSA25057_00-0254332299521921

Davey Bones Skin – The dark skeleton pirate captain has risen from the depths.

Salty Bones Skin – The loyal skeletal crewmate, ready for battle.

Captain Fin Skin – The fierce shark pirate armed with his trident Skyhook.

Hullbreaker Shovel – Smash your way through the farm with this new sunken shovel skin.

Skeleton Parrot Pet – A spooky companion flying by your side.

Cursed Weapon Skins – Haunting new skins for your Shotgun, Shovel, Sniperagus Rifle and Carrocket Launcher.

Heads Up Emote - Don't lose your head with this supporter exclusive emote!

Bone Crew Music Track – Set the tone with this chilling sea shanty.

Exclusive Badges & Titles – Show off your support with pirate-themed rewards.



Thank you for sailing with us! 🌊🌽



NOTE: All items in this pack are purely cosmetic—no pay-to-win here, just a way to show your style while supporting the future of Shotgun Farmers.
